content:
ashley: quick update from the vela8b quant sweep (q4_0 and int6 variants). did a 1k-sample run across longform summarization + multi-turn faq slices.
jon: nice. high level numbers?
ashley: perf/cost first:
```
q4_0 throughput: 820 tok/s (baseline fp16 vela8b: 500 tok/s)
avg latency (p50): 64ms -> 92ms (q4_0 faster)
unit_cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.0013 (q4_0) vs $0.0021 (fp16) -> ~38% cost savings
```
patrick: impressive throughput but what about quality?
ashley: overall ROUGE-2 across the 1k set: fp16=0.412, q4_0=0.392 (-0.02 absolute). EM on extractive QA slice: fp16=0.71, q4_0=0.69. BLEU on paraphrase slices: -0.9 absolute.
jon: so mid-small regressions. is the degradation localized?
ashley: yes, mostly on long entity-copy spans and adversarial reorder prompts. short factual QA and instruction responses are nearly identical.
sre-bot: anomaly-detect: token-entropy spike detected at generation step ~140 in 87 samples.
patrick: can we salvage via selective castback? e.g., run q4_0 but cast to fp16 on entropy spike or when prompt len > 2k?
ashley: tested hybrid experiments: (A) length-based routing (prompt_len>1200 -> fp16), (B) entropy fallback (if token_entropy>5.5 -> fp16). Ran both on the 1k holdout:
```
A blended cost (15% long): 0.15*$0.0021 + 0.85*$0.0013 = $0.00146 (~30% saving)
B fallback triggered on 7% of tokens -> blended cost ~= $0.00147
Quality (ROUGE) for A: 0.409, B: 0.410 (both recover ~70-90% of delta)
```
jon: interesting that entropy fallback recovers more despite lower trigger rate. probably targets the true regressions.
patrick: what's implementation complexity? length-based is trivial, entropy fallback needs runtime support for token-entropy calc and mid-generation route.
ashley: correct. entropy fallback needs a short-lived castback flow and KV cache migration. estimated eng work: 2 sprints to make robust + e2e tests. length-based routing is config-only.
jon: ops-bot can you surface current capacity for adding fp16 capacity if we do length-based routing at 15%?
ops-bot: @eng-ml checking vela8b fp16 pools... headroom: us-west 9%, eu-west 11%. Predicted QPS uplift if 15% long route: +13% on fp16 pools. May need a small reserved slot or cross-region overflow.
patrick: from GTN/product POV we should recommend entropy fallback as preferred (better quality per cost) but deliver length-based routing as a fast follow that requires no infra work.
jon: agree. what about rollout plan and guardrails?
ashley: proposed rollout: 1) start with q4_0 default + entropy-fallback alpha for 5% of traffic (shadow routing) 2) monitor ROUGE/EM and hallucination score, escalate if delta > 1.0 points on key slices 3) after 2 days and stable, increase to 25% traffic and enable active castback. 4) fallback threshold tuning via small grid.
patrick: add metric thresholds: hallucination rate delta < 0.5% and latency P95 < 400ms for UX-critical flows.
jon: unit-econ table for GTN (one-liner): default q4_0 saves ~38% unit cost vs fp16; blended with entropy fallback yields ~30% savings while recovering most quality. recommend q4_0 + entropy-fallback alpha.
ashley: action items:
- ashley: run 5k-sample sweep with entropy-fallback sim and post per-slice deltas (ETA 6h)
- ops: run capacity sim for 15% long length routing across regions (ETA 24h)
- eng infra: estimate dev effort for runtime entropy-fallback castback (2 sprints ballpark)
- product (patrick): draft GTN recommendation doc with UX expectations and safeguards (ETA tomorrow)
jon: thanks. ping me when 5k sweep finishes. :thumbsup:
